notes: Formed when Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn is in its own or exalted sign in an angle. The verses are mostly physical description; body measurements, palm marks, regions ruled and the stated ages at death are omitted.

rules.text: Ruchaka Yoga (Mars): a longish face, fine eyebrows, dark hair and a ruddy complexion; zealous, radiant yet courteous, very powerful and intelligent; fond of contest and a natural conqueror and commander, with a hard edge to the temperament and an interest in mantra and the occult.

Bhadra Yoga (Mercury): a solid build with dark, curly hair; independent by nature yet the protector of the family; shares comforts and pleasures with friends, and lives happily with spouse and children in a position of authority.
rules.note: The verse begins on p. 622, which is missing from the scan (a different page was scanned in its place); paraphrased from the part on p. 623.

rules.text: Hamsa Yoga (Jupiter): a melodious voice, fair complexion, attractive face with a well-formed nose and honey-coloured eyes; intelligent and dignified, with a sensual nature; fond of water and swimming; a contented person of authority who enjoys every comfort.
Malavya Yoga (Venus): attractive lips, a slim waist, a moon-like glow, even teeth, long arms, medium height and a deep voice; attains authority and enjoys comfort and happiness.

Sasa Yoga (Saturn): small teeth, a narrow waist and well-shaped thighs; brave, intelligent, agile and powerful, drawn to forests and hills; skilled with metals; rises to command others. The text also notes a flirtatious streak and a readiness to take what belongs to others.
